en.bdb: One becomes truthful after attaining the Sikh-life

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਰੂਪ ਦੇਖਿ ਇਕਸ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਹੋਰਸੁ ਦੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa roop dhekh ikas baajh na horas dhekhai|

en.bdb: One who has attained Sikh-life does not wish to have glimpse of any (god, goddess) except the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਚਖਣਾ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਫਿਕੈ ਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa chakhanaa lakh a(n)mirat fal fikai lekhai|

en.bdb: To one who has tasted the Sikh-life, million of ambrosial fruits taste mawkish.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਲਖ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਅਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhaa naadh sun lakh anahadh visamaadh alekhai|

en.bdb: Listening to the melody of Sikh-life, one enjoys the wondrous delight of millions of unstruck melodies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਦਾ ਪਰਸਣਾ ਠੰਢਾ ਤਤਾ ਭੇਖ ਅਭੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikhee dhaa parasanaa Tha(n)ddaa tataa bhekh abhekhai|

en.bdb: Those who have come in touch with the Sikh spirit have gone beyond the impacts of :hot and cold, guise and disguise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਦੀ ਵਾਸੁ ਲੈ ਹੁਇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee dhee vaas lai hui dhuraga(n)dh suga(n)dh sarekhai|

en.bdb: Having inhaled the fragrance of Sikh life, one feels all other fragrances as a smell.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਮਰ ਜੀਵਣਾ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee mar jeevanaa bhai bhagat bhai nimakh nimekhai|

en.bdb: One who has started living the ,Sikh way of life, lives every moment in loving devotion.
Subsumed in the 'word of Guru, he remains detached from the world.
